name: datalake-access-analyzer
description: Evaluates the full data-lake access chain for a principal and a governed AWS Lake Formation resource (or a failed request) - Lake Formation permissions and grants, resource links, cross-account RAM shares, IAM identity policy, underlying S3 bucket policy, and KMS key policy - and pinpoints the missing or incorrect grant that causes a denial, including granted-but-unlinked resources and catalog-versus-table grant-scope errors. Produces a ranked, read-only-safe remediation plan. Read-only. Recommends an Agent Toolkit for AWS or custom IAM and Lake Formation MCP and the AWS Documentation MCP as augmentation.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on MON at 13:00 UTC
